"Proceed with the counting-system model, Lieutenant. Incorporate the temporal correlation to our arrival and project the terminus."

The tall turns toward the seated man. "If it's a counting system, those shortening intervals could be a countdown, Captain. Modelling it that way might tell us how much time we have." The tall says in a plain, unhurried voice: "If it started counting when we arrived, we may be what it's counting toward." The tall says in a measured, tactical voice: "I'd also suggest we open our distance. Give us room to manoeuvre if the terminus isn't friendly." The tall says in a quiet, firm voice: "With respect, sir — I don't like sitting this close to something that just woke up."
